name: Consultation on Canada's National Security and Bill C-51
content: Problems and Purpose In debating a proposed Anti-Terrorism Act (Bill C-51), the Government of Canada undertook a series of consultations to engage Canadians, stakeholders, and experts on issues related to national security and the protection of rights and freedoms.
